## Checklist

- [ ] Tests cover the change; a bug fix comes with a test that fails without it.
- [ ] `composer lint`, `composer analyse` and `composer test` pass.
- [ ] `CHANGELOG.md` has an entry under `[Unreleased]`.
- [ ] The documentation in `docs/` is updated, if behaviour, configuration or public methods change.
- [ ] New rules have an official code (or a `QUITTIO-…` code) and messages in English and German.
- [ ] Generated files are regenerated (`php tools/docs/generate.php` after model changes).
